entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to update its tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Old GUTI type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating whether the mobile identity is native GUTI or mapped GUTI.

entities.name: Old GUTI IE
entities.description: Information element containing the old Globally Unique Temporary Identity.

entities.name: Additional GUTI IE
entities.description: Information element containing an additional GUTI provided by the UE.

entities.name: EMM authentication procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for authenticating the UE.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for establishing security context.

entities.name: Conditions for skipping authentication before TAU completion
entities.description: Conditions where MME shall not initiate EMM authentication before tracking area update completion: after handover to S1 mode, target cell is shared network cell, and PLMN identity mismatch conditions.

entities.name: Skip authentication for emergency services
entities.description: MME may be configured to skip authentication and proceed directly to security mode control for UEs with only emergency PDN connections.
